about.title: Sebastopol Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Nobody in Sebastopol expects to be reading about wrongful death law. Yet when a family member dies because someone else was careless — a driver on Rt 116 or Bodega Avenue, a property owner who ignored a hazard, a facility that failed in its duty of care — California gives certain survivors a way to seek accountability in civil court. That civil action is separate from any criminal case, and it can move forward whether or not charges are ever filed. Sonoma County public records show Sebastopol logged 8 injury collisions and 9 people injured in 2025, with no traffic deaths recorded that year. Fatal incidents are uncommon in a town of about 7,678 people, which is exactly why the families who do face this kind of loss often feel isolated in it. LawProactive is a free service. We are not a law firm. We simply connect you with an independent wrongful death attorney who works on contingency, so there is no fee unless your family recovers something. You decide whether to proceed, and at what pace.

whyChoose.title: Why Sebastopol Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Standing rules are handled correctly
items.desc: California limits who may bring a wrongful death claim — a spouse or domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. The attorney we connect you with will sort out who can file so no eligible family member is left out.

items.title: Deadlines are tracked from day one
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a government entity is involved. An early connection protects that timeline while your family grieves.

items.title: Every category of loss is accounted for
items.desc: Recoverable losses go beyond funeral and burial costs to include lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. Contingency representation means no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My family member died in a crash on Rt 12 or Rt 116 near Sebastopol. Does it matter that the state maintains those roads?
items.answer: It can. If a public agency's design or maintenance of a roadway is alleged to have contributed to the death, claims against that agency follow a much shorter deadline than the usual two years. That does not mean a road was at fault — most claims still center on a driver's conduct — but an attorney should evaluate every potential party early so nothing is lost to a missed filing window.

items.question: The other driver was charged criminally. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and runs on its own track, independent of any criminal prosecution in Sonoma County. Families sometimes choose to coordinate timing with counsel, but the civil case does not depend on a conviction, and the two-year deadline keeps running regardless of what happens in criminal court.

items.question: Sebastopol is a small town and I do not want to involve strangers. What happens after I contact LawProactive?
items.answer: You will have a private, no-cost conversation about what happened, and we will connect you with an independent attorney if that is what you want. There is no obligation to hire anyone, and nothing you share is used to pressure you. The attorneys in our network handle wrongful death cases on contingency, so there is no upfront cost and no fee unless there is a recovery.
